metadata.dataset: GHSL UCDB R2024A V1.2 + OpenStreetMap cities/towns
metadata.province_source: geoBoundaries gbOpen IRN ADM1, commit 9469f09; OpenStreetMap/Wambacher, boundary year 2017, ODbL 1.0
metadata.method: Select Iran records; read OGC GeoPackage geometry in Pyodide; simplify 50 m preserving topology in source Mollweide CRS; transform ESRI:54009 to EPSG:4326; retain city polygons intersecting province polygon; retain complete city footprints and holes; representative points are label anchors.
metadata.interpretation: GHSL urban footprints (2025) plus OSM city/town points. Point positions are not municipal polygons. Province filtering uses geoBoundaries; source snapshot is not a hydrological date.
metadata.processing: Browser Pyodide (sqlite3, Shapely, pyproj); no backend GIS processing
metadata.labels: Persian display names keyed by original GHSL identifier; original names retained; geometry never edited to match a label.
metadata.license: GHSL acknowledgement; OSM points ODbL 1.0; geoBoundaries province source ODbL 1.0
metadata.osm_method: OSM place=city/town nodes in retrieval envelope; exact province covers filter in Pyodide; same-name major city deduplicated; original point geometry retained.
